task:
Download and save two images from httpbin.org to the Downloads folder:
1. JPEG image from https://httpbin.org/image/jpeg → save as 'httpbin_image.jpeg'
2. PNG image from https://httpbin.org/image → save as 'httpbin_image.png'

Both files must exist in /home/user/Downloads/ with the exact filenames specified.

verification.description: JPEG image saved as httpbin_image.jpeg in Downloads
PNG image saved as httpbin_image.png in Downloads
